canonical_name: Properties of recursively enumerable sets (topic family; exact proposition open)
statement_blocker: The catalog names a subject but no property. It selects neither a computable-enumerability model nor a carrier, binders, hypotheses, conclusion, encoding transports, or boundary cases, and it does not choose among definition/domain/range characterizations, closure laws, semidecidability, decidable-versus-r.e.-and-co-r.e., halting completeness, or neighboring set/degree results. Selecting one would invent or substitute mathematics.
